panel.ai-not-song: Classified as not a song by AI

youtube_fallback.label: YouTube fallback
youtube_fallback.description: Use yt-dlp chapters for YouTube videos when available.

yt_dlp_path.label: yt-dlp binary path
yt_dlp_path.description: Leave empty to find yt-dlp in PATH, or enter an absolute executable path.

llm_backend.label: LLM backend
llm_backend.description: Use only this backend for track identification. Select Disabled to turn identification off.

ollama_api_key.label: Ollama API key
ollama_api_key.description: Optional for a local server without authentication. Enter a key if your server requires one.

ollama_model.label: Ollama model
ollama_model.description: Name of an installed Ollama model.

ollama_endpoint.label: Ollama endpoint
ollama_endpoint.description: API base URL including /v1, or a full /chat/completions URL. Supports Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible servers.

openai_api_key.label: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

openai_model.label: OpenAI model
openai_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: gpt-5-mini.

openai_endpoint.label: OpenAI endpoint
openai_endpoint.description: API base URL including /v1, or a full /chat/completions URL. Supports Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible servers.

anthropic_api_key.label: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

anthropic_model.label: Anthropic model
anthropic_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: claude-haiku-4-5.

gemini_api_key.label: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

gemini_model.label: Gemini model
gemini_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: gemini-2.5-flash.

xai_api_key.label: xAI API key
xai_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

xai_model.label: xAI model
xai_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning.

groq_api_key.label: Groq API key
groq_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

groq_model.label: Groq model
groq_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: llama-3.3-70b-versatile.

deepseek_api_key.label: DeepSeek API key
deepseek_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

deepseek_model.label: DeepSeek model
deepseek_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: deepseek-flash.

mistral_api_key.label: Mistral API key
mistral_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

mistral_model.label: Mistral model
mistral_model.description: Model for track identification. Default: mistral-small-latest.

llm_max_tokens.label: LLM output token limit
llm_max_tokens.description: Enter a positive whole number. Maximum output tokens per request, including reasoning where applicable. Default: 32768. Must be supported by the selected model.

openrouter_api_key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used only when this backend is selected. Settings are stored as plain text.

openrouter_model.label: OpenRouter model
openrouter_model.description: Model for track identification with web search. Default: ~google/gemini-flash-latest.

album_art_only.description: Show only the album artwork (no text).
album_art_only.label: Album art only

hide_album_art.description: Hide the artwork and its fallback icon.
hide_album_art.label: Hide album art

hide_when_no_media.description: Hide the widget when no MPRIS player is active.
hide_when_no_media.label: Hide when no media

local_lyrics_dir.description: Folder with local .lrc files named 'Artist - Title.lrc'; searched before LRCLIB.
local_lyrics_dir.label: Local lyrics folder

max_length.description: Maximum widget length in pixels — the text area width (long titles scroll or truncate to fit it).
max_length.label: Max length

offset_ms.description: Shift lyric timing: positive values show lines earlier, negative later.
offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset (ms)

panel_size.description: Size preset of the lyrics panel: compact (440), medium (520), large (640). The bar widget and control-center tile open this preset.
panel_size.label: Panel size

player_allowlist.description: Comma-separated player names (identity or bus name). When set, only matching players are shown. Empty = show any player.
player_allowlist.label: Player allowlist

player_blocklist.description: Comma-separated player names (identity or bus name) to hide. Empty = hide none.
player_blocklist.label: Player blocklist

show_lyric_line.description: Show the current synced lyric line in the chip instead of the artist (title stays).
show_lyric_line.label: Show current lyric line

title_scroll.description: Scroll long titles that exceed the max length.
title_scroll.label: Title scroll

use_cache.description: Store fetched lyrics in the plugin data directory for offline reuse.
use_cache.label: Cache lyrics
